answer: Because the zenith record is per identity, the prism audit recounts the streak and a reset is visible in the ledger. That makes a farm's early mistakes expensive in a way that compounds, because every alias restarts separately and none of them can inherit another's whisper standing. Promotion out of probation demands 13 consecutive epochs with no upheld complaint, so a single bad verdict resets the clock entirely. That is 31 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
